description: Angular component for selecting time units and values, implementing ControlValueAccessor and Validator for form integration.

classes.name: TimeUnitSelectComponent
classes.description: Angular component for selecting and converting time units with form validation and control.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes form group, sets up value change subscriptions, and validation logic.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions on component destruction.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers callback for value change propagation.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls based on input.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets form values based on a numeric time value, converting to appropriate unit.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Returns validation errors if form is invalid.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates the external model with the selected time in milliseconds.

methods.name: calculateTimeUnit
methods.description: Determines the most appropriate time unit for a given value.
